bills.label: S 9947
bills.title: Relates to the collection and use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes
bills.summary: Updates provisions regarding the collection and use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes by the Centerport Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association.

bills.label: A 7839
bills.title: Relates to the Nesconset Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association
bills.summary: Relates to the Nesconset Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; provides for the purpose of such association, and its use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

bills.label: S 9968
bills.title: Establishes the Harris Hill Volunteer Fire Company Benevolent Association
bills.summary: Establishes the Harris Hill Volunteer Fire Company Benevolent Association; provides for eligibility of membership, purpose, powers and duties, organization meeting and by-laws, the control and disposal of funds and property and the precept for payment of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

bills.label: S 10187
bills.title: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Bethpage
bills.summary: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Bethpage, Nassau county, New York, Inc.; changes "firemen" to "firefighters"; directs that certain taxes received shall be used by such benevolent association in furtherance of its purposes.

bills.label: A 10052
bills.title: Extends the effectiveness of the authority of the town of Red Hook to impose real estate transfer taxes and to deposit revenue from such tax
bills.summary: Extends the effectiveness of the authority of the town of Red Hook to impose real estate transfer taxes and to deposit revenue from such taxes into a community preservation fund.

bills.label: S 10727
bills.title: Prohibits retaliation by cooperative housing programs against shareholders
bills.summary: Prohibits cooperative housing programs from engaging in adverse actions and retaliation against shareholders.

bills.label: A 11039
bills.title: Allows the alteration or repeal of real property tax exemptions for private institutions of higher education
bills.summary: Allows the alteration or repeal of real property tax exemptions for private institutions of higher education.
bills.sponsors: Grace Lee (primary); Claire Valdez (cosponsor); Stefani Zinerman (cosponsor)

bills.label: S 5057
bills.title: Increases the state subsidy for school lunch meals
bills.summary: Increases the state subsidy for school lunch meals where at least thirty percent of the school breakfast service, lunch service and reimbursable snack program food was purchased from New York state farmers, growers, producers or processors in the preceding year.
bills.sponsors: Michelle Hinchey (primary); George Borrello (cosponsor); William Weber (cosponsor)

bills.label: A 1962
bills.title: Enacts "Francesco's law"; repealer
bills.summary: Enacts "Francesco's law" which establishes violations for the failure to safely store rifles, shotguns, and firearms in the presence of a minor or a prohibited person; requires the office of gun violence prevention to collect and analyze statistical and other information and data with respect to injuries or deaths of minors resulting from failure to safely store a firearm, rifle, or shotgun.
bills.sponsors: Khaleel Anderson (primary); Rebecca Seawright (cosponsor); Brian Cunningham (cosponsor); David Weprin (cosponsor); Catalina Cruz (cosponsor); Jeffrey Dinowitz (cosponsor)

bills.label: S 7236
bills.title: Prohibits the purchase of ammunition if such purchaser failed a background check
bills.summary: Prohibits the purchase of ammunition if such purchaser failed a background check, is prohibited by federal law or is subject to a temporary or extreme risk protection order issued pursuant to article sixty-three-A of the civil practice law and rules.

bills.label: S 10730
bills.title: Requires Medicaid coverage of applied behavior analysis therapy rendered during school hours
bills.summary: Requires Medicaid coverage of applied behavior analysis therapy rendered during school hours in certain schools.

bills.label: S 9205
bills.title: Relates to requirements for the appointment of a guardian for personal needs or property management
bills.summary: Provides for requirements for the appointment of a guardian for personal needs or property management; requires financial institutions to provide all necessary bank statements for a Medicaid application to a requesting department of social services or other state or local agency administering public assistance or medical assistance within a reasonable amount of time of receipt of such request; requires a banking organization, branch in this state of an out-of-state bank or foreign banking corporation to provide such records within thirty days of receipt of such request.

bills.label: S 9516
bills.title: Relates to the exemption of certain parcels of land from the licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of
bills.summary: Relates to the exemption of certain parcels of land from the licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises.

bills.label: A 11443
bills.title: Relates to commercial food fish licenses
bills.summary: Relates to the issuance of commercial food fish licenses.

bills.label: A 11437
bills.title: Relates to license fees required to be paid by wholesale beer licensees to sell cider
bills.summary: Requires wholesale beer licensees to only need to pay a one time additional license fee to sell cider.

bills.label: S 10732
bills.title: Establishes minority youth-owned business enterprises
bills.summary: Establishes minority youth-owned business enterprises in the state of New York and the city of New York; creates certain contracting opportunities for members of minority youth-owned business enterprises; establishes an implementation program and oversight committee for minority youth-owned business enterprises.

bills.label: S 10729
bills.title: Allows drivers to contest license revocations, suspensions, and other penalties based on cases of mistaken identity and require identity ver
bills.summary: Require the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish that the record of the adverse action actually matches the person the department has penalized by establishing a three-point match with the licensee rather than just a name match; allows a driver to contest the determination if they believe it is a case of mistaken identity; provides for a stay/removal of any penalty until there is a final determination.

bills.label: S 10731
bills.title: Relates to the responsible AI safety and education (RAISE) act
bills.summary: Amends provisions relating to the training and use of artificial intelligence frontier models under the RAISE act.

bills.label: A 6495
bills.title: Enacts the Trevyan Rowe child and young teen mental health community safety act
bills.summary: Enacts the "Trevyan Rowe child and young teen mental health community safety act"; directs boards of education to create policies, procedures, and guidelines for at-risk children and young teens who have demonstrated suicidal ideation, been victims of harassment or bullying, and/or who have eloped from school property; establishes a commission to evaluate the safety and security of children in primary and secondary public and private schools in this state.
bills.sponsors: Harry B. Bronson (primary); Rebecca Seawright (cosponsor); Harvey Epstein (cosponsor); Jo Anne Simon (cosponsor); Maritza Davila (cosponsor); Deborah Glick (cosponsor)

bills.label: A 10343
bills.title: Relates to fees and expenses in unemployment insurance proceedings; extending effectiveness
bills.summary: Extends provisions of law providing for certain fees and expenses in unemployment insurance proceedings to December 31, 2028.

bills.label: S 8454
bills.title: Relates to the residency requirement for the St. Lawrence county public health director and community services director
bills.summary: Exempts persons holding the offices of public health director and director of community services of St. Lawrence county from the requirement that such person be a resident of the political subdivision or municipal corporation of the state for which such person shall be chosen or within which such person's official functions are required to be exercised.
